main.summary: Restores a concrete DataItem payload after a rejected content mutation.
main.remarks: The memento is captured while the DataItem data gate is held and is invoked before the shared protection metadata snapshot is restored.

field.name: restore
field.summary: Type-specific action that restores payload and derived state on the item.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a payload memento from a restoration action.
constructor.param: Action that restores the prior payload state.

method.name: Restore
method.summary: Restore the captured payload state to a DataItem.
method.param: Item whose payload and derived state are restored.
